app.title: Stalwart is now a drop-in replacement for Microsoft Exchange
app.description: Stalwart is an open-source, high‑performance, multi‑tenant mail server that replaces Microsoft Exchange with a unified mailbox, calendar, and collaboration stack.
proposed_tests: Clone the repository and run `make docker` to launch a local instance
Create a test mailbox and send an email via SMTP, then fetch via IMAP
Import a calendar event and verify it appears in the web UI
Measure average email delivery latency compared to a Dockerized Exchange image
